# Dunfey Hotel — WWDC as data

Every Apple WWDC session since 2014, indexed: categories, durations,
on-screen code, transcripts (7 languages), cross-references, and the
resources each session cites — including items Apple later delisted,
preserved from dated snapshots. All content links to developer.apple.com;
nothing is rehosted.

## Machine-readable data

- /data/sessions.json   — all sessions: id, title, year, topics, duration,
                          snippet count, resource ids, transcript languages
- /data/topics.json     — topic taxonomy with glyph URLs
- /data/events.json     — WWDC editions with dates
- /years/{year}/resources.tsv — per-edition resource catalog (TSV)

## URL grammar

- /sessions/{id}/                       e.g. /sessions/wwdc2026-303/
- /years/{year}/  /topics/{slug}/
- /observatory/?years=2020,2026&topics=spatial-computing&measure=hours
  — every view is URL-addressable; selections are shareable and citable.

Session ids are Apple's own (wwdc{year}-{number}). Data is rebuilt from
Apple's public feed; the footer stamp carries the snapshot number and date.
